module: Flowgraph node 'Split' (simple category). Decomposes a table (vec3, color or quat, 4 elements max) into numbers x, y, z, w.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: Writes table[1..4] to x, y, z, w (empty table if the input is nil).
